name: Sonic
contract: native (Sonic chain, chain id 146); wrapped wS 0x039e2fB66102314Ce7b64Ce5Ce3E5183bc94aD38

red_lines.hack_exploit: none on Sonic found; Fantom-era incidents (Multichain bridge collapse, Jul 2023) predate S
red_lines.mint_path_live: yes: no hard cap; governance has approved repeated new issuance (airdrop 190.5M, ongoing funding 47.6M a year for 6 years, 472.4M institutional issuance on 4 Sep 2025, plus a possible $50M ETF issuance)
red_lines.team_wallet_to_exchange_during_pump: yes: the Fantom Foundation-labelled wallet sent 40.5M S to a Binance deposit on 21 Aug 2026 (+29.8% day); a Sonic issuance-signer wallet sent 76.6M S on 9-10 May 2025 pump days to a market-maker-like wallet
red_lines.treasury_selling: 292.5M S (~$11.7M) from the 150M-S 'Sonic USA'-sized issuance wallet, the Fantom Foundation wallet and the ongoing-funding wallet went to one Binance deposit address (Mar-Aug 2026); not disclosed as sales

front_matter_extras.revenue_mechanism: About $6k a month of revenue; no burn, buyback or fee share of size.
front_matter_extras.pump_day_price_source: Gate S_USDT UTC daily closes, re-run 16 Nov 2026 with scripts/pump_day_test.py (50 of 360 days); the body's earlier count used CoinGecko daily closes
